deltas.behavior_text: A cross-box member-lane forward sends the destination's announced served_id (role name fallback), not the backend name the plan's c20 specified ('primary' 404s on every gateway)
Member lanes resolve first in handle_post, before _peer_only_forward, so a non-hosting box (Thor) pins a member name instead of pool-forwarding it as the plain role
GET /v1/models lists a member lane only when it can answer: the self lane needs its backend ready, a peer lane needs the role in the peer's probed ready_roles
stt-/tts-/innereye- names no longer forward a chat request to a peer (the pre-existing suffixed-lane path could, rewriting model to e.g. 'stt'); they now 404
